content: Rifabutin is an antimycobacterial agent classified as a semisynthetic ansamycin antibiotic, which is chemically derived from rifamycin S. It is marketed under the brand name MYCOBUTIN and is available in capsule form for oral administration. Each MYCOBUTIN capsule contains 150 mg of rifabutin, USP, as the active ingredient. Additionally, the capsules include the following inactive ingredients: microcrystalline cellulose, magnesium stearate, red iron oxide, silica gel, sodium lauryl sulfate, titanium dioxide, and edible white ink. The chemical name of rifabutin is 1',4-didehydro-1-deoxy-1,4-dihydro-5'-(2-methylpropyl)-1-oxorifamycin XIV, as listed in the Chemical Abstracts Service (9th Collective Index). Its stereochemical designation is (9S, 12E, 14S, 15R, 16S, 17R, 18R, 19R, 20S, 21S, 22E, 24Z)-6,16,18,20-tetrahydroxy-1'-isobutyl-14-methoxy-7,9,15,17,19,21,25-heptamethyl-spiro[trienimino]-2H-furonaphth[imidazole]-2,4'-piperidine]-5,10,26-(3H,9H)-trione-16-acetate.
